messages.subject: For Fernando Fernandez | Global affairs, sustainability and emerging-market execution
messages.body:
Dear Unilever Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Fernando Fernandez, Chief Executive Officer.

Unilever's global footprint requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability priorities and operating teams, particularly across emerging markets. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of global affairs, government relations, sustainability and emerging-market execution might support Unilever's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Unilever.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
